summary: Wrote a seven-phase sequential implementation plan for the universal cover of a doubly serial digraph, integrating all eight research findings and re-deriving every load-bearing file:line anchor independently. Phase order follows the research report's own layering: the ForMathlib acyclicity criterion and the Saturation-parameterised FrameOver constructor first (both independent of the carrier), then the reduced-walk carrier, the structural lemma plus the three IsOrientedForest fields, the two one-step lifts plus seriality and surjectivity, the iterated lifts plus TwoWayBounded, and the assembly with the full gate set. The three pinned Lean Challenge Statements were compile-verified at plan time (snapshot --dry-run --compile reported OK), and validate-artifact.sh passes with zero warnings.

artifacts.summary: Seven-phase sequential plan, 9 hours estimated, covering the ForMathlib acyclicity criterion, the ofStepSat frame constructor, the cover carrier, the oriented-forest proof, the lifts, two-way boundedness, and the L-plus truth-transfer assembly.
